ruleDefinitions.name: Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature Command PowerShell
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detect built in PowerShell cmdlet Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature, Deployment Image Servicing and Management tool.
Similar to DISM.exe, this cmdlet is used to enumerate, install, uninstall, configure, and update features and packages in Windows images
 Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Disable\\-WindowsOptionalFeature.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Online.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-FeatureName.*")) AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Windows\\-Defender\\-Gui.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Windows\\-Defender\\-Features.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Windows\\-Defender.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Windows\\-Defender\\-ApplicationGuard.*")))
